# Coggno

> > Coggno is a comprehensive LMS platform offering 10,000+ compliance training courses across HIPAA, HR, financial regulations, and workplace safety.

Coggno provides organizations with flexible, scalable compliance training solutions through both à la carte courses and subscription plans. The platform specializes in regulated industries including healthcare, finance, and enterprise HR, with certifications covering HIPAA, OSHA, AML, FCPA, and workplace compliance standards.
